newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia October load factor up at 74.21 pc.
newsitem.headline: Iberia October load factor up at 74.21 pc.

text.p: Iberia said its passenger load factor rose to 74.21 percent in October from 72.62 percent in September.

It flew 1.38 million passengers in the month and clocked 2.39 billion revenue passenger kms, taking the total so far this year to 12.38 million passengers (an increase of four percent on the same period 1995) and 21.84 billion revenue passenger kms (up nearly seven percent on last year).

Cargo carried was up 16.6 percent on the same month last year at 72.41 million freight tonne kms, taking the total in the first nine months of this year to 594.34 million tonne kms, an increase of nine percent.
The monthly passenger load factor was the highest the state-owned carrier has achieved this year and coincides with its move to cut fares aggressively on a number of domestic and European routes.
